limitations: The tabulated nine-point isotherm is for synthetic phosphate solutions, not real digestate.
The real digestate result is a separate text-level maximum across a dose range; no dose-specific curve, replication, or uncertainty was tabulated in the accessible factsheet.
The report gives measured qe values; no values were recalculated or fitted here.
Digestate matrix is chicken manure, not grass-derived digestate; chloride, organics, competing ions, and pH applicability require validation.
Reference-only; no adsorption isotherm or recovery coefficient is activated in GreenHub.
applicability: Useful source data for checking adsorption models and documenting matrix effects; not a predictive parameter for GreenHub nutrient recovery.
